paragraphs.text: Ouagadougou Thomas Sankara International Airport (OUA/DFFD) serves as a key air gateway for Ouagadougou, BF, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 04/22: 3000 m (9843 ft) asphalt.

Ground transportation options connecting Ouagadougou Thomas Sankara International Airport with central Ouagadougou include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from OUA should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Ouagadougou Thomas Sankara International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Ouagadougou Thomas Sankara International Airport is OUA and the ICAO code is DFFD.

faqs.q: Which city does OUA airport serve?
faqs.a: Ouagadougou Thomas Sankara International Airport (OUA) serves Ouagadougou, BF.
